questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to express strong disapproval?
explanation: Reprimand is correct - R-E-P-R-I-M-A-N-D. It means to rebuke or scold someone officially.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a serious or unlucky event?
explanation: Catastrophe is correct - C-A-T-A-S-T-R-O-P-H-E. It means a sudden disaster or calamity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning impossible to satisfy?
explanation: Insatiable is correct - I-N-S-A-T-I-A-B-L-E. It means always wanting more and never satisfied.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a strong desire for something?
explanation: Compulsion is correct - C-O-M-P-U-L-S-I-O-N. It means an irresistible urge to behave in a certain way.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning easily swayed by others?
explanation: Susceptible is correct - S-U-S-C-E-P-T-I-B-L-E. It means likely to be influenced or affected.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning the study of the Earth?
explanation: Geography is correct - G-E-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. Geo means earth; graphy means writing or study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a state of confusion?
explanation: Bewilderment is correct - B-E-W-I-L-D-E-R-M-E-N-T. It means the state of being utterly confused.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very harmful?
explanation: Deleterious is correct - D-E-L-E-T-E-R-I-O-U-S. It means causing harm or damage.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to treat someone unfairly?
explanation: Discriminate is correct - D-I-S-C-R-I-M-I-N-A-T-E. It means to treat a group differently and unfairly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning beyond what is reasonable?
explanation: Exorbitant is correct - E-X-O-R-B-I-T-A-N-T. It means unreasonably excessive in price or amount.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to officially accuse?
explanation: Prosecute is correct - P-R-O-S-E-C-U-T-E. It means to bring criminal charges against someone.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to strengthen?
explanation: Reinforce is correct - R-E-I-N-F-O-R-C-E. It means to strengthen or support.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a statement of disagreement?
explanation: Dissent is correct - D-I-S-S-E-N-T. It means to have or express a different opinion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning capable of being understood in more than one way?
explanation: Ambiguous is correct - A-M-B-I-G-U-O-U-S. It means open to more than one interpretation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a sudden change?
explanation: Metamorphosis is correct - M-E-T-A-M-O-R-P-H-O-S-I-S. It means a complete transformation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a person who walks?
explanation: Pedestrian is correct - P-E-D-E-S-T-R-I-A-N. It means a person on foot.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a strong feeling of enthusiasm?
explanation: Exhilaration is correct - E-X-H-I-L-A-R-A-T-I-O-N. It means a feeling of great happiness and excitement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a secret plan to do harm?
explanation: Conspiracy is correct - C-O-N-S-P-I-R-A-C-Y. It means a secret plan made by a group to do something harmful.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning not open to argument?
explanation: Irrefutable is correct - I-R-R-E-F-U-T-A-B-L-E. It means impossible to deny or disprove.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a feeling of sorrow for wrongs done?
explanation: Contrition is correct - C-O-N-T-R-I-T-I-O-N. It means sincere remorse for wrongdoing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning not allowed?
explanation: Prohibited is correct - P-R-O-H-I-B-I-T-E-D. It means officially forbidden.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to honor greatly?
explanation: Venerate is correct - V-E-N-E-R-A-T-E. It means to regard with great respect and reverence.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning the study of government?
explanation: Political science is correct - P-O-L-I-T-I-C-A-L S-C-I-E-N-C-E. It is the study of government and political systems.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to make someone feel less anxious?
explanation: Reassure is correct - R-E-A-S-S-U-R-E. It means to say things to make someone less anxious.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a period of rapid growth?
explanation: Proliferation is correct - P-R-O-L-I-F-E-R-A-T-I-O-N. It means rapid increase in numbers.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning showing skill and cleverness?
explanation: Ingenious is correct - I-N-G-E-N-I-O-U-S. It means clever, original, and inventive.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a great mass of people?
explanation: Multitude is correct - M-U-L-T-I-T-U-D-E. It means a large number of people or things.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning the quality of being open and honest?
explanation: Transparency is correct - T-R-A-N-S-P-A-R-E-N-C-Y. It means being open and not hiding anything.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning able to exist in nature without being replenished?
explanation: Sustainable is correct - S-U-S-T-A-I-N-A-B-L-E. It means able to be maintained without causing damage.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning an official order or law?
explanation: Legislation is correct - L-E-G-I-S-L-A-T-I-O-N. It means laws made by a governing body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to change the direction of?
explanation: Divert is correct - D-I-V-E-R-T. It means to cause to change direction.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning able to be believed?
explanation: Credible is correct - C-R-E-D-I-B-L-E. It means capable of being trusted or believed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning going beyond the bounds of what is acceptable?
explanation: Transgression is correct - T-R-A-N-S-G-R-E-S-S-I-O-N. It means an act that goes against a rule or law.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning capable of moving quickly?
explanation: Agile is correct - A-G-I-L-E. It means able to move quickly and easily.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a view about something?
explanation: Perspective is correct - P-E-R-S-P-E-C-T-I-V-E. It means a particular way of thinking about something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning producing abundance?
explanation: Prolific is correct - P-R-O-L-I-F-I-C. It means producing many works, results, or offspring.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a powerful feeling of fear?
explanation: Trepidation is correct - T-R-E-P-I-D-A-T-I-O-N. It means a feeling of fear or anxiety about something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to hold back?
explanation: Withhold is correct - W-I-T-H-H-O-L-D. It means to refuse to give or suppress information.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning the state of being dependent on drugs?
explanation: Both dependency and dependence are correct - D-E-P-E-N-D-E-N-C-Y. Dependency and dependence are both accepted spellings.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning deeply absorbed in thought?
explanation: Contemplative is correct - C-O-N-T-E-M-P-L-A-T-I-V-E. It means spending time considering or giving thought to something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning the practice of being economical?
explanation: Frugality is correct - F-R-U-G-A-L-I-T-Y. It means the quality of being economical with money.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning relating to all countries?
explanation: International is correct - I-N-T-E-R-N-A-T-I-O-N-A-L. It means existing between or involving many countries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning unclear or hard to understand?
explanation: Ambiguous is correct - A-M-B-I-G-U-O-U-S. It means open to more than one interpretation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to make something legal?
explanation: Both legitimize and legitimise are correct - L-E-G-I-T-I-M-I-Z-E. Legitimize is American; legitimise is British spelling.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very determined?
explanation: Resolute is correct - R-E-S-O-L-U-T-E. It means admirably determined and unwavering.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning completely certain?
explanation: Categorical is correct - C-A-T-E-G-O-R-I-C-A-L. It means unconditional and absolute.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to make a law?
explanation: Legislate is correct - L-E-G-I-S-L-A-T-E. It means to make laws.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a formal agreement?
explanation: Covenant is correct - C-O-V-E-N-A-N-T. It means a formal agreement or promise.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning the killing of a large number of people?
explanation: Massacre is correct - M-A-S-S-A-C-R-E. It means the killing of many people in a cruel manner.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to break a promise?
explanation: Renege is correct - R-E-N-E-G-E. It means to go back on a promise or commitment.
